blocks.html: Pull reports other units filed to the TAK Server, narrow them down, and save the ones you need to your own device.

slides.title: Search the server
slides.html: You need a live TAK Server connection. Select Search, type your text, then select Search again to run it. Matching reports fill the list and green icons mark their locations on the map.

slides.title: Narrow with filters
slides.html: Select Filter to add parameters such as Current Map View, Date Range, Limit Shown To or Report Type. You can stack more than one at a time, then select Confirm to update the results.

slides.title: Download a report
slides.html: Select a report in the list to expand its summary and pan to it on the map. Select Download to the right of the entry to save a local copy. The map icon changes from green to white once it is saved.

slides.title: Edit a local report
slides.html: Open the saved report from the Reports panel. Select Details (from the list or the map marker radial) to view and edit it, change the fields you need, then select Save Draft for a local copy or Upload to save and send.

slides.title: Show or hide on the map
slides.html: Select the Visibility button to toggle whether the report shows on the map. Use it to clear clutter without deleting your local copy.
